name: QiYi 3x3 (Magnetic, Glow in the Dark)
description: The QiYi 3x3 (Magnetic, Glow in the Dark) is a fun, beginner-friendly magnetic speed cube that stays visible when the lights go out. Piece magnets add crisp alignment “clicks” so turns feel more accurate and controlled, while the glow-in-the-dark plastic charges under light and then shines in darkness—perfect for night practice, gifting, and display. With a modern 55.
features: Magnetic accuracy: Magnets guide layers into place for faster, more consistent turning.
Solve in the dark: Glow-in-the-dark material keeps the cube visible for nighttime solves.
Easy glow activation: Charge it under sunlight or room light — UV light works best, but regular light works too.
Comfortable handling: 55.5 mm size balances speed and control for most hands.
Display-worthy look: Glossy finish + glow effect makes it a standout cube on a desk or shelf.
Expose the cube to light (sunlight, room light, or UV light).
